modern: First, do nothing thoughtlessly, nor without a purpose. Second, make your acts aim at nothing other than a social end.
original: First, do nothing inconsiderately, nor without a purpose. Second, make thy acts refer to nothing else than to a social end.

explained.summary: Two rules for action. First, don’t do anything at random or without a reason. Second, make sure what you do is aimed at the common good, the benefit of the people around you, and not only at yourself. For the Stoics, humans are made to live and work together, so acting for others is acting according to our nature.
explained.today: Before saying yes to another project, or spending an evening drifting between apps, ask what it’s for. And when you do act, ask who else it helps: the team, the family, the neighbour who could use a hand with the shopping.
